note: The current official Department of Social Work page publishes a minimum 72-unit Study Scheme, its Year 1-4 placement pattern and the complete Social Work Major Course List. This supplement exposes the 31 courses in that Major list plus SOWK1001, the named Social Work Faculty Package course required by the Study Scheme. The 72-unit path consists of 9 Faculty Package units, fixed Major courses, one of SOWK3240/SOWK3250, and at least three Year 4 options from SOWK4030 and the published Seminar pool. SOWK2050 is explicitly optional in the Year 2 summer. The Major table leaves the SOWK4580 units cell blank, so its local credits value remains 0 to mean unknown rather than assuming the 3-unit value of neighbouring seminars. The two additional cross-department Faculty Package courses and the separate requirement to take at least one PSYC and one SOCI course remain open pools whose current Programme-specific rows are not closed by the Department page. The resulting 32-course list is intentionally browse-only and must not be presented as a complete 72-unit graduation audit.
